detached entry will mark the parent successful<br></li><li>Succeeded entries allow the next instruction to proceed (not vec or set bits)<br></li><li>Upon poison, parent entry is never checked since it style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;" value="<ul><li style="text-align: left;"><b>TLB_HEAD:</b> tlb translates addresses, blocking on a miss. Exceptions are marked (misaligned should be marked by the generators since info is lost after packing)</li></ul><ul><li style="text-align: left;"><b>EXE_HEAD:</b> executes (LOADS ONLY). Also acts as a stopper for head since it maintains sync with the parent entry's v_head</li></ul><ul><li style="text-align: left;"><b>HEAD:</b> head cleans up successful entries. It also executes (STORES ONLY). On a store's exception, an early report signal is sent and pointer is frozen until the poison bit is noticed (guarantees other store packets of the instruction are poisoned too)<br></li></ul>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="148.34" width="440" x="2135" y="1811.66" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ukONA6y_UWqhSFneLrVA-951" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=3;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="130" x="182" y="758" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ukONA6y_UWqhSFneLrVA-952" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=3;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="130" x="480" y="758" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ukONA6y_UWqhSFneLrVA-953" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=3;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="160" x="320" y="640" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ukONA6y_UWqhSFneLrVA-955" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;" value="<div style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 18px;"><b>Speculative State</b></span></div><div><span style="text-align: left;">Architectural state must be checkpointed for vector operations in the LSU as well. Beyond simply keeping the b_masks fresh and maintaining poison bits, we also need to rewind the dsq/dlq ptrs and the v_head of the stq/ldq. on mispredicts and exceptions&nbsp;</span></div>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="187.8" x="2612.2" y="1577.59" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ukONA6y_UWqhSFneLrVA-957" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;rounded=0;" value="<div style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 18px;"><b>Execution State</b></span></div><div style="text-align: left;">Loads can speculatively execute whenever possible. No problem for vector!</div><div style="text-align: left;">Stores typically execute after retiring. However, for vector, we need to start executing to guarantee safety. So they execute when they are the oldest memory instruction when the pnr is pointing to it (not guaranteed safe by pnr but it is the only instruction stopping from the pnr proceeding)</div>"
